name: elasticache-cluster-rightsizer
description: Analyzes Amazon ElastiCache (Redis, Valkey, and Memcached) node utilization - memory pressure against maxmemory, engine and host CPU saturation, evictions, cache hit rate, connection load, and read-replica replication lag - to identify over- and under-provisioned nodes and recommend an optimal node type, shard count, and read-replica count. Read-only and recommend-only. Distinct from health monitoring and serverless cost tracking; this is node rightsizing. Recommends the AWS Pricing MCP as augmentation.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on SUN at 06:00 UTC
